name: I’ll Break Panes Up, With Him!
source:
SHOW US THAT SWEET PANE!!!
3!
2!!
1!!!

It's time for America's favorite game show: Pane Is Money!
The only thing standing between you and §200,000 is five rounds of panes—sugar glass panes.
Join our protagonist, The Contestant, as he breaks the panes up, with him: The Host.
Will you go home a sweet dry winner or a bitter wet loser?

[From [url=https://wagleunagi.itch.io/ill-break-panes-up-with-him]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
让我们看看那块甜蜜的玻璃板！
3！
2！
1！

美国最受欢迎的游戏节目《玻璃就是金钱》开播啦！
挡在你与§200,000奖金之间的，只有五轮玻璃板挑战——当然，是糖玻璃。
跟随主角“参赛者”，和他——“主持人”一起，把玻璃板砸个粉碎。
你会干干爽爽地抱着甜蜜的胜利回家，还是浑身湿透、苦涩落败？

[摘自[url=https://wagleunagi.itch.io/ill-break-panes-up-with-him]itch.io[/url]]
